Subject: CloudSyndicate marketplace sync & next steps (tech deep-dive)

Hi Priyom / Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the quick overview of Redwood’s marketplace flow. As discussed, CloudSyndicate (our distribution partner) would like to run a technical deep-dive that covers:

- integration surface (S3 + signed URLs for model artifacts)
- auth patterns for marketplace listings (API keys vs OAuth)
- expected telemetry / billing handoff

Proposed next step: a 60-minute tech session where our engineering lead (Ravi) walks through their marketplace connector and we go over the mutual action plan. Our preferred windows (PT):

- Tue, Jul 25: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed, Jul 26: 09:00–10:00

Attached: CloudSyndicate_MAP_v2.pdf (draft MAP) + cloudsyndicate_tech_questions.csv (pre-read).

Can you confirm which slot works and which Redwood engineers should join? Also please confirm whether you need a short ingress demo account for the marketplace sandbox.

Cheers,
Leah
Leah Chan
Partner Programs — CloudSyndicate

Quick reply to align:

- We can do Tue 25 Jul 15:00–16:00 PT (that works best for our infra lead). If that fills, Wed 26 Jul 09:00–10:00 PT is our secondary.
- Attendees from Redwood: myself (partner lead), Vanessa (partnerships / marketplace PM), Ben (infra/ops). We may add one engineer for the runbook section.
- Agenda proposal (60m):
  1) 5m — intros & objectives
  2) 25m — CloudSyndicate connector architecture + security model (Ravi)
  3) 20m — Redwood marketplace integration points + billing/telemetry flow (Ben)
  4) 10m — open Q&A / next steps / ownerships (capture MAP items)

Vanessa — can you confirm which Redwood PM will join and whether we should invite someone from product security for the auth/billing portion?

Leah — if Tue 15:00 PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short Zoom and include the MAP + tech questions. Also, quick ask: can you indicate whether the connector requires elevated roles in the sandbox (service account or scoped keys)? That will determine how Ben preps the infra demo.

Thanks,
